cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Make the Second Step First
cards.instruction: Get them to accept a small consequence that makes the larger risky action feel already underway.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Pay the climbing-course deposit before we discuss the cliff.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. It's refundable only if we attend the first lesson.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: So paying makes not climbing harder.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. A small commitment can do the worrying for us.
